name: io.github.48x-ai/marketbasketanalysis-mcp
description: Co-purchase intelligence and merchant ops tools for AI shopping, ecommerce, and B2B agents

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <mba_live_ API key>, minted in the merchant admin (API keys page)

headers.name: X-MBA-Base
headers.description: Optional backend override; must be an MBA-operated plane (app.marketbasketanalysis.com or bigcommerce.marketbasketanalysis.com)

headers.name: X-MBA-Platform
headers.description: Optional platform hint (shopify, bigcommerce, woocommerce, magento, orocommerce)

environmentVariables.name: MBA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Per-store MBA API key (mba_live_...), minted in the merchant admin

environmentVariables.name: MBA_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Override for self-hosted WooCommerce/Magento backends; defaults to the MBA hosted backend

environmentVariables.name: MBA_PLATFORM
environmentVariables.description: Store platform (shopify, bigcommerce, woocommerce, magento, orocommerce); drives per-platform path mapping and tool gating
